landmarks.name: Washington Square Arch
landmarks.fact: Built in 1892, this marble arch celebrates the centennial of George Washington's inauguration as the first U.S. President.

landmarks.name: Washington Square Park
landmarks.fact: Located in Greenwich Village, this iconic public park features a famous central fountain and vibrant cultural gatherings.

landmarks.name: Union Square Park
landmarks.fact: Established in 1839, Union Square is known for its historic gatherings, popular Greenmarket, and vibrant public space.

landmarks.name: George Washington Equestrian Statue
landmarks.fact: Dedicated in 1856 in Union Square, this is the oldest outdoor statue managed by New York City Parks.

landmarks.name: Tammany Hall Building
landmarks.fact: Built in 1929, this historic building with a distinctive glass dome served as the headquarters of the Tammany Hall political machine.
